messages:
morgan: FYI — Customer reported an outbound wire was returned by their bank. Return note: 'Payment returned — beneficiary account currency mismatch (instructed USD, beneficiary account EUR)'. Trace ID TX-49382. Customer says funds were debited on their side. Can payments/finance confirm next steps? @elaine @reza

elaine: Got it. Can you paste the raw instruction they sent (MT103 or payment order)? need beneficiary account format (IBAN vs account+sort) and SWIFT code. Also, did the customer explicitly request USD settlement?

morgan: Pasting the payment order snippet the customer shared:

```
Beneficiary: Novellus GmbH
IBAN: DE44500105175407324931
BIC: NOVLUS33XXX
Amount: 12,500.00 USD
Value date: 2026-03-15
Ordering customer: Novellus Health (US)
Payment reference: INV-9921
Trace: TX-49382
```

elaine: Thanks. That IBAN is a DE (EUR) account. Receiving bank likely refused USD instructions because beneficiary account is EUR-denominated and they won't do on-us FX. Our instruction was USD credit to beneficiary — mismatch. Do we have any MT103 extra fields (e.g., /CURRENCY/USD) or proprietary tags?

morgan: Customer insists they instructed USD and expected the receiving bank to convert. They attached the bank's notice showing debit from their account and a returned status from the beneficiary bank. They've asked for either a reversal or for us to re-send in EUR.

reza: High level: if receiving bank already returned the payment, we need to confirm funds are back in our nostro. Steps: 1) Open SWIFT recall/trace with our correspondent quoting UETR/Trace TX-49382. 2) Ask receiving bank for reversal and reason code. 3) If reversal succeeds, we can reissue in EUR per customer's preference (but they must accept any FX/fees). I'll start the recall now.

elaine: Our outbound bank shows a return with internal code 'AM04 - Instruction Mismatch / Currency incompatible with beneficiary account'. I'll file a SWIFT query (MT199) and include UETR: 4f3b9a2c-81d9-4c2a-a7e0-1b5f3c9b2d11. Note: we'll need customer's written consent to cover any re-issue fees or FX spread before finance re-sends.

morgan: I told the customer we'll escalate and asked them to sign the fee consent form. Also asked whether they prefer we re-send in EUR to the DE IBAN or insist on USD (and we'll route via a USD correspondent to a USD-denominated account if they provide one). They replied they prefer EUR credit if possible.

payments-bot: payment-id: pay_2394823 status: RETURNED reason: CURRENCY_MISMATCH returned_at: 2026-03-15T17:42:10Z

reza: Action items summary — (a) I'll file the SWIFT recall and confirm if funds are en route back to nostro (expect 24-48h), (b) Morgan: collect customer's signed fee consent + confirm EUR preference (done), (c) Elaine: once funds confirmed returned, finance to reissue in EUR and update ticket with FX rate/fees. Marking P1. Ticket #7921.

elaine: Also note for ops: update our payment validation to flag IBAN country vs instructed currency mismatch earlier (preventive). I'll raise a small patch to validation rules.

morgan: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and attach this plan. Will ping when consent received. :thumbsup:
